text: "Come, let us return to the Lord, [AA]For it is he who has torn, but he will heal us;he has struck down, but he will bind our wounds.
He will revive us after two days;on the third day [1] he will raise us up, [AB]to live in his presence.
Let us know, let us strive to know the Lord;as certain as the dawn is his coming.He will come to us like the rain,like spring rain that waters the earth." [AC]
What can I do with you, Ephraim?What can I do with you, Judah?Your loyalty is like morning mist,like the dew that disappears early.
For this reason I struck them down through the prophets,I killed them by the words of my mouth; [2] [AD]my judgment shines forth like the light.
For it is loyalty that I desire, not sacrifice,and knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings. [AE]
But they, at Adam, [3] violated the covenant;there they betrayed me.
Gilead [4] is a city of evildoers,tracked with blood.
Like brigands lying in waitis the band of priests.They murder on the road to Shechem, [5]indeed they commit a monstrous crime.
In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing:there is found Ephraim's prostitution,Israel is defiled.
For you also, Judah,a harvest [6] has been appointed!
